chunks: As for what al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, concerning

regarding a man who performs wudu (ablution) and forgets to wash his penis. He said: He should wash his penis and then repeat the wudu (ablution). So this is to be understood as recommended and encouraged, in light of the earlier reports which indicate that repeating the wudu (ablution) is not obligatory for him, and contradiction in their statements is not permissible.
ai.seo_question: If someone forgets to wash his penis before wudu (ablution), must he repeat the wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This report discusses the ruling on one who performs wudu (ablution) but forgets to wash his penis. The apparent instruction to repeat the wudu (ablution) is interpreted as recommendation rather than obligation, based on earlier hadith reports that negate the necessity of repetition.
